spec_match.rationale: Teaches the correct feature-detection pattern for new syntax (probe in a separate module, catch the SyntaxError) and the migration shape.

interactive.rationale: Live probe reports supported/fallback; the recommended load path runs accordingly (real import defer or labelled lazy import()).

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes SyntaxError (unsupported) from probe-load errors; shows exact flag steps and a convergent migration snippet.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5071131271888896, the TC39 proposal, and MDN.

conformance.rationale: conformance.json asserts grammar parse, Symbol.toStringTag='Deferred Module', and deferred-until-first-access evaluation.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless 141: probe reports unsupported with the real SyntaxError; fallback lazy import() path loads the module and is labelled; console clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: showcaseTelemetry.assert on supported and unsupported/fallback branches.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; button bg+color together; WCAG AA; amber note blocks for flag guidance.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls, aria-live status, dl/ol semantics, visible focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360 or 1280; tap targets >=44px; both classes verified.

guidanceConsulted.query: feature detection unsupported API fallback state accessible status region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Communicate async/dynamic state through role=status/aria-live; use native controls with visible labels; semantic tables with caption/scope.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Support verdict and step readouts use role=status / <output aria-live=polite>; controls are native buttons/selects; step and fact lists use semantic markup.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Headless a11y: support banner announced on resolve; buttons carry text names; focus visible.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel and code blocks on narrow mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Contain wide content (pre/tables) with overflow-x:auto and scrollbar-gutter:stable; grid auto-fit for control rows; no body horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Code samples use <pre> with overflow; step/col grids use repeat(auto-fit,minmax); measured no overflow at 360 and 1280.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP: overflow=0px at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 on all concept pages.

summary: The page is most useful precisely on the unsupported baseline it runs on: it demonstrates the real detection pattern and an honest dynamic-import() fallback, never a faked success.
